**The native build of 1.4.1.** It's the same code as 1.4.1, published so panels on the **Native** channel get the security fixes too. The Rust system helper gets the same hardening as the Bun one. It only accepts the panel's own user, keeps its files where only root can change them, and makes updates and rollbacks safe.

Testing: follow [Testing the Rust agent](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/native-1.4.1-native.1/docs/testing/testing-rust-agent.md) on a spare VPS.
